item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 03/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China tomorrow. A band of clouds will cover the coastal areas. A dry replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China midweek this week. It will be windy over the region. The weather will be mainly fine in the following couple of days. It will be slightly cooler in the morning. Besides, the area of low pressure over the western North Pacific to the east of the Philippines will strengthen gradually and move towards the vicinity east of Luzon Strait in the next few days. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement and development.
